Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical manual page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The military vision exemption is dated in the manual as effective May eighteenth of the edition year; the date is reported as printed and was not checked against a later SCDMV notice [A03].
The point-halving example uses a June ticket exactly as the manual does; no other point values per violation are given in these pages, so none are stated [A06].
The provisional license section carries two date cutoffs from the manual; whether further law changes followed is not stated in this edition [A09].
The Temporary Alcohol License paragraph says to return the license when a suspension is sustained using the word should, and when rescinded using the word must; facts keep that distinction [A11].
Fees, mailing addresses, the delivery time for renewed licenses and the payment plan minimum are service details that can change and are isolated as dynamic.
